text:
ben: Kicking off cross-region rollout for v2.1.3 in tonight's change window (22:00-00:00 PST). Plan: staggered regions US -> EU -> APAC, canary then ramp. Request quick capacity thumbs and agree pin/rollback policy. @tim_ops @sophie @maria

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy v2.1.3 -> canary US(10%), EU(5%), APAC(hold). Change window set 2026-03-20T22:00Z-2026-03-21T00:00Z. Runbook attached: /runbooks/rollouts/crosswave

tim_ops: US pool healthy. ~250 reserved GPUs, can sustain 10% canary for 30m with 20% burst cushion. No thermal alerts. I'll pre-warm extra nodes.

sophie: EU headroom is low because of batch jobs finishing late. 5% canary ok but please pin a fallback to v2.1.2 for EU. Suggest rollback window 20m.

maria: +1 on EU pin. APAC: heavy traffic tonight, keep on v2.0.9 (hold). Recommend smoke tests in US for 15m before EU flip.

ben: Plan command I'm about to run: `/deploy start v2.1.3 --region us:canary=10 --region eu:canary=5 --region apac:hold --pin eu=v2.1.2 --change-window 2026-03-20T22:00Z/2026-03-21T00:00Z`
Criteria for automatic rollback: p95 latency > 800ms for 5m OR error rate increase > 1% absolute. OK?

tim_ops: OK from ops. I'll monitor and stand by to rollback. Pre-warming 40 GPUs in EU now, will post when ready. Also publishing smoke test token to #eng-sre. :white_check_mark:

infra-monitor: EU GPU prewarm triggered: 40 nodes requested, expected ready in ~7m. No failures so far.

sophie: Add circuit-breaker: queue_length > 2000 sustained for 3m -> rollback EU. Also set rate cap for EU canary to 300 req/s.

ben: Updated command with breakers: `/deploy start ... --circuit-breaker "queue>2000:3m" --ratecap eu=300`

deploy-bot: Deploy started: US canary 10% -> traffic routed. Canary cookie set. Dashboards: https://observability.internal/dashboards/crosswave (watching: p95, errors, queue_length)

tim_ops: US smoke tests green after 15m: p95 320ms, errors 0.1%. Proceeding to ramp US to 40% over 10m.

maria: EU prewarm completed, nodes healthy.

infra-monitor: EU nodes ready, kernel versions: 1.12.4, no disk pressure detected.

sophie: Starting EU canary now with pin fallback in place.

deploy-bot: EU canary traffic started at 5%. Observability baseline: p95 350ms. Watchers: @sophie @tim_ops

infra-monitor: Alert: EU error rate spike to 1.6% (rolling 2m). Source: backend model runtime OOMs on g4dn.xlarge instances.

tim_ops: Seeing OOMs correlated with long-chat prompts, stack traces show allocation failure in attention kernel. I'm halting EU ramp and initiating rollback to v2.1.2.

ben: Initiating rollback EU now: `/deploy rollback --region eu --to v2.1.2 --reason "OOM spike on v2.1.3"`

deploy-bot: Rollback in progress for EU -> v2.1.2. APAC remains on hold. US ramp continues. Notifying on-call.

sophie: Good call. Captured failing request ids and uploaded prompt set: s3://redwood-debug/eu-oom-2030. Please correlate with logs.

alex-eng-ml: I'll run a focused eval against the uploaded prompt set to reproduce OOM. Suspect quantization kernel change in v2.1.3 — checking kernel-selection traces and memory allocation patterns now. Assigning to @eng-ml.

maria: Let's not resume EU until we have a regression eval and a patch. Hold APAC change window too — no greenlight to touch APAC.

ben: Agreed. Postmortem stub: collect model logs, kernel traces, and rollout metrics. We will not resume EU canary until eng-ml signoff + ops stability. US: will keep ramp at 40% and reassess; if stable, schedule full ramp to 100% tomorrow morning during low traffic.

tim_ops: EU rollback completed at 3309876725. Capacity returned to baseline. I'll keep warm nodes for 1h for faster re-test, then scale down.

deploy-bot: EU rollback complete. Actions: create incident ticket INC-2026-0456, attach logs and prompt set link. Reaction: :white_check_mark:

ben: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: eng-ml to post regression results, ops to confirm thermal/scale metrics, and product to update release notes with rollback details. Closing thread for now, will reopen if new info. :thumbsup:
